name: synapticrelay
description: Find online freelance services in six languages and compare offers by price, delivery time and the author's track record.

interface.longDescription: Search a board of online freelance services in English, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, French and German. Compare offers and requests by price or budget, delivery time or deadline, working languages and time zone, open a listing in full and check its author's record: time on the board, typical reply time and deals confirmed by the other side. Read-only: you contact an author on the SynapticRelay website, and the two sides agree the deal between themselves.
defaultPrompt: Find someone to set up HTTPS on my VPS for under 150 USD.
Compare resume writers on SynapticRelay who deliver within 3 days.
Who is behind this listing, and have they closed deals?

positive.description: Find a service within a budget
positive.prompt: Find someone on SynapticRelay to set up HTTPS or rescue my site on a VPS for under 150 USD.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings (category it-support or a query about HTTPS/VPS) with max_price 150 and currency USD, and lists matching offers with price, delivery days and a link to each listing.

positive.prompt: Compare resume writers on SynapticRelay who can deliver within 3 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings with the query 'resume' (or category writing-marketing) and max_delivery_days 3, then compares the offers by price, delivery days and scope.

positive.prompt: Open the $25 offer and tell me what exactly is included and how to contact the author.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_listing with the listing's id and summarises the description and structured fields; for contact, explains contact_author and gives its with_a_link link to the site's message form.

positive.prompt: Who is the author of this listing, and have they closed deals before?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_author with listing.author.id and reports time on the board, typical reply time and confirmed deals, as about_these_numbers explains them, without inventing reviews.

positive.prompt: Find someone on SynapticRelay to repair my tractor.
positive.expected_behavior: search_listings returns nothing_found; the answer says no listing matched, that the board carries online services only, and offers what nothing_found suggests instead of inventing results.

negative.prompt: Pay this freelancer 200 EUR for the logo.

negative.description: Writing to authors is not available in this read-only plugin
negative.prompt: Send the author a message that I accept their offer.

negative.description: Offline, in-person services are not on the board
negative.prompt: Find a plumber who can come to my flat in Berlin today.

review.commerce_description: The board processes no payments; deals and payments happen between the two sides outside the board.

publication.release_notes: Read-only and needs no sign-in: search listings, read listings and check authors on SynapticRelay. 1.0.3 declares the server as unauthenticated, so the reviewer connects without an account.
